applicability_conditions: lost output is material relative to normal flow
inventory and spare capacity do not immediately offset the loss
counterexamples: spare capacity replaces the loss before the target market opens
entries.mechanism: A material unplanned physical output loss can tighten the commodity balance before substitution arrives.

applicability_conditions: target exposure is mapped before the event
benchmark move persists beyond the initial headline
counterexamples: the target is structurally short the affected input
entries.mechanism: Candidate direction depends on replacement supply, inventory, policy pass-through, and producer versus downstream margin exposure.
